text:
elaine_sales: Heads-up — MeridianPay is asking about a migration plan from CompetitorX. Main asks: POC to prove prompt parity, short timeline (2 weeks), security questionnaire answers, and a delta on pricing. Can we scope?
matt_se: I can drive the POC. Quick q: do they need request/response parity (drop-in) or are they okay with adapter + prompt tweaks?
elaine_sales: They want as close to drop-in as possible; brand legal wants identical behavior for a month while they run A/B. But engineering also expects some prompt adjustments.
matt_se: Ok. Plan suggestion: 1) small adapter that maps CompetitorX JSON -> Redwood API, 2) a prompt translation layer for templating differences, 3) smoke tests for top 20 prompts. Can do in 10 business days if infra ready.
dave_engineer: We should call out tokenization differences and stop-sequence behavior. CompetitorX uses post-token trimming, our default streaming may change final punctuation. Need a compatibility flag.
matt_se: Good point — we can add a compatibility mode: `accept_input_format: competitorx_v1` and `compat_stop_mode: emulate_competitorx`. Minimal runtime branch.
nana_product: (note: user is ana_product) We already have a compatibility shim prototype in a private branch; it handles input->prompt mapping and stop tokens. I can hand it over.
nora_security: Re: security questionnaire: MeridianPay sent an SOC/PCI preflight. Major asks: data residency, encryption keys, access controls, audit logs, and third-party subprocessors. I can draft answers but need confirmation on on-prem option and KMS integration.
dave_engineer: For Private deployment we support customer-managed KMS and VPC peering. For Dedicated we have KMS integration (customer keys) and audit logs retained 90 days by default.
elaine_sales: They asked for timeline to get security answers back — they want the filled questionnaire within 48 hours. Is that realistic?
nora_security: I can populate 80% in 24 hours, will need input from infra on exact retention windows and from legal on subprocessors.
matt_se: For the POC infra, we need a staging workspace with sample API key, 2 IP allowlist entries for their test harness, and a small dedicated instance for stable latency. Ops-bot, can you provision a 1-node sandbox?
deploy-bot: request received: provision sandbox-ephemeral for sales/poc/meridianpay. ETA 6 hours. (this is an automated message)
dave_engineer: Also flagging a potential enterprise blocker: Their contract requires guaranteed response parity tolerances (BLEU-like score) and a fallthrough to CompetitorX during divergence. We need to confirm legal on fallback clauses.
nana_product: For parity metrics, propose we use a 3-tier check: exact-match rate, semantic-similarity (embedding cosine >= 0.92), and manual QA for top 5 intents. That should satisfy risk assessment.
matt_se: Example curl we can give them for the adapter (quick snippet):
```bash
curl -X POST https://redwood.example.com/v1/compat 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD-POC-KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"competitor_request": {"prompt": "translate: ...", "stop": ["\n\n"]}}'
```
Use this to validate wire-format mapping.
elaine_sales: Pricing — they asked about delta vs CompetitorX. They currently pay a flat endpoint price + overage. We need a simple comparison: hosted per-token vs their committed monthly spend for Dedicated or Private licensing.
matt_se: I'll draft 3 scenarios: 1) Hosted (pay-as-you-go), 2) Dedicated (reserved capacity with commit), 3) Private (license + infra). Estimate numbers after I get their current monthly token count.
nora_security: MeridianPay also wants answers on data retention and purge-on-request. We support on-demand deletion API and per-customer retention policy; need to confirm timeframe for backup deletion (~7 days after request).
dave_engineer: Note: When emulating stop-token behavior we sometimes add 1–2 tokens of noise; include an automated diff tool to flag regressions in CI.
matt_se: Action items: 1) ana to share shim branch (owner: ana_product, ETA: today), 2) nora to draft security Q responses (owner: nora_security, ETA: 24h), 3) ops-bot to provision sandbox (owner: deploy-bot, ETA: 6h), 4) matt to produce pricing scenarios + POC runbook (owner: matt_se, ETA: EOD tomorrow).
elaine_sales: Good. I'll send MeridianPay a kickoff calendar for tomorrow 9am PT once we have the runbook. Also sharing their questionnaire here: https://drive.redwood.example/meridianpay-soc-pci (internal link).
nana_product: Attached note: the shim currently supports `stop_mode` and `token_trim=true`, but we need a small change to mimic competitor n-best sampling for reranking. I'll open PR.
nora_security: If legal needs us to sign AUP or subprocessors list, ping me and I'll escalate.
matt_se: I'll draft the POC checklist in the shared doc and tag owners. Short timeline but doable.
elaine_sales: Thanks team — keep this thread updated with any blocker. :thumbsup:
